## ScreenShotPP v0.6.0

A fully native rewrite: the interface is now pure Rust ([egui](https://github.com/emilk/egui)),
with no embedded web view.

### New

- **Native interface.** Settings, capture overlay, countdown, recording HUD, and
  recorder are native windows. The web view and its runtime are gone.
- **New logo and app icon.**
- **Resize the capture area from its corners.** In addition to the four side
  handles, each corner now has a handle that moves its two edges at once.
- **Move the capture area.** With the select tool, drag inside the area (outside
  any annotation) to move it. Its size is unchanged and it stays on screen.
- Cursors show when a handle resizes or the area can be moved.

### Fixes

- Capturing on a secondary monitor with a different display scale (for example a
  laptop at 150 % and an external screen at 100 %) no longer misplaces or
  mis-sizes the overlay. The recording HUD is fixed the same way.

### Notes

- Existing settings from v0.5.1 are kept.
- Screen recording remains available on Windows and macOS.
- The Windows installer remains unsigned and may display a SmartScreen warning.
